title: Reel · HRT myth flip — the headline that scared a generation (Ranjana, 52)
caption:
Myth: HRT causes breast cancer. WHI's actual number: 8 extra cases per 10,000 women a year — in women averaging 63. NAMS 2022: under 60, benefits usually win for hot flashes. Send this to her.
Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#menopause #perimenopause #hormonetherapy #womenshealth #hotflashes

scenes.text: Everyone had an opinion, and every one of them stopped her from asking a doctor.
phrases: "My aunt got cancer from those pills."
"I googled it till 2am and gave up."
Nobody mentioned the study was on women her mother's age.

scenes.text: Under 60, or within 10 years of your last period? Benefits usually *outweigh* risks for hot flashes (NAMS 2022).
phrases: Estrogen-only arm: no rise in breast cancer (WHI).
She wasn't reckless. She was reading old headlines.

phrases: Two worst symptoms + how many times a week.
Take the page in — don't rely on memory.
